about: Hey! I'm Adrian, a 3rd year Computer Engineering student at UofT interested in graphics…

li_projects.title: RATH - Vulkan Rendering Engine
li_projects.description: A game engine I am currently building in C++ with Vulkan. So far, I have implemented the basics of Vulkan (swapchain, renderpasses, graphics/compute pipelines, and command buffer syncs). A glTF model loader, asset manager, free-fly camera, and diffuse lighting shaders have also been added. This is all controllable in run-time through an ImGui menu.

li_projects.title: OpenGL Shader Renderer
li_projects.description: A multi-pass deferred C++/OpenGL renderer with three non-photorealistic GLSL shaders: cel shading (inspired by Guilty Gear Xrd), crosshatch/screentone, and isophote contours. Features two-tone cel lighting, rim lighting, screen-space outlines from normal and depth buffers, and a ping-pong Gaussian bloom pipeline with HDR tone mapping.

li_projects.title: GANTerrainGen
li_projects.description: A DCGAN trained on satellite data (Copernicus elevation + ESA WorldCover) to procedurally generate 256x256 terrain maps, benchmarked against a Perlin fBm baseline. Created as my APS360 final project. Build a real-time C++/OpenGL visualizer to inspect training checkpoints live.

posts.text: Computa graphics is cool.
